description: bulk_start_upload fails. On the webpack path the inner webpack plugin is fail-soft: build green, maps deleted, exceptions unresolved. On the Turbopack path the upload runs in runAfterProductionCompile and fails the build, leaving the maps Next wrote. Before @posthog/nextjs-config 1.11.6 (webpack-plugin 1.7.4 inside) the webpack path kept the hidden maps.
